about: The 3D lane's fixed questions for the parts library (board/plans/archive/2026-11-09-parts-libraries-plan.md, P0): new pieces in a brief's words, written before any method was run on them (q01 is the plan's rim probe). Every method's top answers are pooled and labelled blind by two labellers (labels.json); `kit parts 3d eval` scores each method on them. Add a question only from real work, never to suit a method.

questions.brief: car wheel rim: a round alloy rim, five spokes from a centre hub out to the barrel, raised lips at both edges, lug nut holes on a bolt circle, machined metal finish
ship's helm wheel: a wooden wheel with eight turned spokes through a brass hub, the spokes run past the rim as handles, the rim built from curved pieces pinned together
revolver cylinder: a steel cylinder with six chambers bored evenly round the centre pin, flutes cut between the chambers, a ratchet star at the back, blued finish
hanging shop sign: a painted wooden board with carved lettering, hung by two chains from a wrought-iron wall bracket with a scroll, the bracket bolted to the wall
oil lantern: a brass fount and burner, a glass chimney held inside a wire guard cage, a folding wire bail handle on top, a ring to hang it by
crossbow: a wooden stock with a steel bow lashed across the front, a string, a trigger lever under the stock, a stirrup at the nose to cock it, iron fittings riveted on
stone well: a round wall of fitted stones with a capstone lip, two timber posts holding a turned winch roller with a crank handle, a rope and a wooden bucket with iron hoops
knight helmet: a steel great helm, a hollow rounded dome with a narrow eye slit, breathing holes drilled in rows, riveted reinforcing bands, a brass trim along the edge
pocket watch: a gold round case with a hinged lid, a crown and bow at the top, an enamel dial with numerals and two hands, a glass crystal, engraving on the back
street bench: cast-iron side frames with scroll legs, wooden slats along the seat and back screwed to the frames, a painted finish worn at the edges
